arguments.question: Analyze ANET’s operating outlook and valuation as of the latest completed-session close. Use issuer/SEC evidence for Q2 2026 results, Q3 2026 guidance, AI networking demand, customer concentration, competition, supply constraints and cash generation. In one integrated calculation, produce values from forward P/E, EV/revenue and a five-year DCF, with explicit, non-consensus assumptions, bridge enterprise value to equity value, per-share outputs, percentage differences from the dated close, and explain why methods diverge. Also calculate and interpret a bear/base/bull annual EPS×P/E grid for the fiscal period controlled by available fiscal-calendar evidence, reconcile scenario EPS with reported interim GAAP EPS and company non-GAAP guidance without mixing bases, and provide reverse expectations/break-even inputs. Separately identify dated third-party analyst consensus/targets if the registered source supports timestamps; otherwise state unavailable. Deliver a concise thesis, counter-case, observable reversal conditions, and stop once one primary issuer filing/results source plus the available dated consensus snapshot are sufficient; do not search repeatedly for unavailable consensus.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines ANET business quality, upside/downside valuation boundaries, and whether the current price embeds aggressive operating assumptions over the 5/21/63-session mandate.
